3 board types (SPEEDSTER/TANK/GLIDER), PARENA-tuned accel/friction/max-speed/gravity, frame-rate-independent momentum model. New PC_PACKET_HOVERBOARD_TOGGLE wire packet, V key to mount/cycle. Found+fixed a real friction-model bug (per-tick vs per-second decay) via the test suite's own convergence assertion. bigo_hoverboard_test.c + real scratch integration harness both pass ASan/UBSan clean. bazel test //day/packages/... 32/32 green, real server+client builds clean. NORTHSTAR/CHANGELOG/README updated. BIG_O a2d9219, PARENA c7fa311.
